mechanism: Use stable alternating singles for two visible speaking turns, separate them with one clearly readable pause, then return to the first subject for a final silent facial or posture response. The source evidence supports turn order, pause and reaction only; any sincerity, advice, literalness or joke premise belongs to the new instance and must not be presented as source-derived meaning.

invariants.rule: Keep one stable table axis and matching eye lines.
invariants.purpose: Makes the alternating singles feel continuous.

invariants.rule: Make the first speaking turn visibly complete before one readable pause.
Keep the second speaking turn compact and minimally gestured.
invariants.ablation_failure: A long second performance flattens the final return.

invariants.rule: Insert a silent expectation slot after the second turn.
invariants.purpose: Allows the reply to land visually.
invariants.ablation_failure: An immediate reaction cut feels mechanical.

invariants.rule: End on the first subject's non-speaking response without an additional speaking turn.
invariants.ablation_failure: A third line restarts the exchange.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source exact facial beats and camera boundaries
